prompt: What is QC 1000 and does it affect our December 2026 year-end integrated audit?
assertions: Identifies QC 1000 as the PCAOB quality control standard taking effect December 15, 2026
Describes the September 9, 2026 amendments: rescinded the design-only requirement and the External QC Function requirement, and let firms choose their annual evaluation date
States the SEC approved the amendments on November 2, 2026 with the effective date unchanged
Explains it governs audit firms' quality control systems, so it affects the auditor rather than imposing direct issuer obligations
Advises discussing with the auditor how QC 1000 affects the 2026 year-end audit
